cases.name: Kylene Douglas
cases.about: Her Go Fund Me said: "With shattered hearts, Wendy and those who love Kylene Douglas honor a beloved mother of three daughters, a woman of faith, and a cherished friend whose life was tragically taken by domestic violence. Kylene was funny, loving, caring, and could light up any room. Kylene loved the Lord, family, and especially the daughters. Kylene’s beautiful spirit and the love that was given will never be forgotten. Kylene was fighting for life, freedom, and the future, while trying to safely escape an abusive relationship and seeking protection through the courts. Kylene deserved to be safe. Kylene deserved to be heard. Kylene deserved to live. Kylene deserved to watch the daughters grow, celebrate their accomplishments, and share in every milestone."
cases.narrative: She reportedly call 911 and said "he's trying to shoot me." While speaking with dispatch personnel, sounds consistent gunfire and a male voice could be heard in the background before the call was disconnected. Police found her and a dog deceased from gunshot wounds.
